title: Does TikTok Promote Work? The Truth About Reach, ROI, and Account Health
summary: Does TikTok Promote actually work, or does it hurt your account? We break down how it affects reach, ROI, and what Reddit users say, plus when it's worth it for followers and sales.
body_markdown:
## Frequently Asked Questions


### Does TikTok Promote work for getting more views?


Yes, TikTok Promote can work for increasing views because it buys additional paid distribution for a selected video. More views are a distribution outcome, not proof of profitable performance, so measure profile visits, follows, or conversions tied to your specific campaign goal.


### How much does TikTok Promote cost?


TikTok Promote pricing depends on the budget and duration you set when building the campaign, since you control both settings in the app. Set a spending limit you can afford, run it as a controlled test, and compare attributed revenue or goal-related outcomes against the cost.


### Does TikTok Promote hurt your organic reach?


No, TikTok Promote does not ruin your account or permanently reduce organic reach. The claim that paid promotion damages future distribution is stronger than the available evidence, since video performance varies with topic, opening seconds, retention, and audience response.


### Is TikTok Promote better than Ads Manager?


TikTok Promote is better when you want a focused, in-app boost to an existing video with a simple setup. Ads Manager is the stronger choice when you need more campaign controls, advanced audience options, or a structured approach to running paid ads at scale.


### How do I know if my TikTok Promote campaign is working?


A TikTok Promote campaign is working when it produces the specific action tied to your objective, not just raw views. If you want followers, track profile visits and new followers. If you want sales, compare attributed orders and revenue with your total campaign cost.


### When should a brand use TikTok Promote?


Use TikTok Promote when your video communicates its value quickly, your target audience is clearly defined, and you have a specific outcome to measure. It is a weaker bet when you boost a video simply because organic views disappointed you and you have no plan to track what viewers do next.


### Does TikTok pay you $1 per 1000 views?


Creator payouts vary based on the monetization program, video performance, watch time, and region, so earnings per 1000 views fluctuate rather than hitting a fixed rate.
